metadata.methods_description: EEG data were recorded from 15 participants (14 at 2500 Hz, 1 at 5000 Hz sampling rate) performing three auditory oddball sequences presented consecutively in counterbalanced order. Each participant completed the Optimum-1 sequence for MMN assessment, learning-oddball for P3b assessment, and local–global paradigm for local and global effect assessment. Stimulation parameters and event timestamps are provided in source data files, with corrected event markers accounting for occasional trigger skipping by the recording system.
